stories.headline: The Macy's parade is postponed for the first time
stories.summary: The 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City was due to be held on Thanksgiving Day, 26 November. Severe weather pushed it to the following Saturday morning, 28 November. The parade was cancelled from 1942 to 1944 amid World War II, but it had never before been postponed.

stories.headline: Puerto Rico wins Miss Universe for a sixth time
stories.summary: The 75th Miss Universe pageant was held at the José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum in San Juan, Puerto Rico, on 24 November. Jennifer Barreto of Puerto Rico won the competition, succeeding Fátima Bosch of Mexico. She is the first married woman and mother to win it, and the sixth titleholder from her country.

stories.headline: Fragrance makers are fined for sharing sensitive information
stories.summary: The European Union and the United Kingdom have fined three fragrance manufacturers: Firmenich, Givaudan and International Flavors & Fragrances. The companies exchanged commercially sensitive information between 2019 and 2023. The fines total more than €570 million.

stories.headline: A Pakistani astronaut reaches China's space station
stories.summary: Shenzhou 24 launched from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center on 25 November and docked with the Tiangong space station at 03:56 UTC. It is carrying the Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first Pakistani to reach orbit, for a one-week visit. Its commander, Tang Hongbo, is the first Chinese astronaut to visit the station three times.
